svg.title: Two bar charts over 13 codebases against Graphify 0.9.91 (Python). Left, faster on all 13: Graphicle's 0.1.1 memory engine (a pre-release build) took 3.0× to 22.7× less time across code-only extract, priming update and update with no change, in all 39 measurements; Kubernetes extract 22.7× (one run each). Same machine, 3 CPUs each; the graphs differ slightly (node counts within 4.7%, edge counts within 2.0%). Right, lower peak memory in all 39 measurements: 0.29× to 0.97× of Graphify's peak, on a pre-release memory build; the graphs differ.
svg.desc: Graphicle against Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) on 13 codebases. Two bar charts. Speed: Graphicle's 0.1.1 memory engine (a pre-release build, 611eb188) against Graphify 0.9.91 on the same machine, 3 CPUs and 8 workers each, one session per program, not interleaved, 15 Oct 2026; median of 3 runs (1 for Kubernetes and VS Code). The graphs differ slightly: node counts within 4.7%, edge counts within 2.0%. Memory: pre-release memory build c5435033; Graphicle's peak RSS or PSS, whichever is larger, against Graphify's peak PSS; the graphs differ. A build of the merged 0.1.1 source stayed below in the 5 measurements rechecked. Speed and memory tables and method: github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md Graphify is a trademark of its owners; no affiliation or endorsement. 1) Faster on all 13 codebases. Graphify 0.9.91's time ÷ Graphicle's. Graphicle took less time in all 39 measurements and in every run. kubernetes 22.7× (all operations 17.1× to 22.7×); rails 7.0× (all operations 7.0× to 7.3×); flask 6.9× (all operations 6.0× to 8.1×); prometheus 6.6× (all operations 6.0× to 6.6×); react 6.2× (all operations 5.7× to 6.2×); scikit-learn 6.1× (all operations 6.1× to 6.5×); pandas 5.8× (all operations 5.8× to 6.8×); vscode 5.4× (all operations 5.0× to 5.6×); ripgrep 5.3× (all operations 4.2× to 5.3×); tokio 5.1× (all operations 4.5× to 5.1×); redis 4.3× (all operations 4.0× to 4.7×); next.js 4.0× (all operations 3.3× to 4.0×); spring-boot 3.3× (all operations 3.0× to 4.3×). 2) Lower peak memory in all 39 measurements. Graphicle's peak ÷ Graphify 0.9.91's peak, 13 codebases × 3 operations. ripgrep 0.31× (all operations 0.31× to 0.85×); flask 0.37× (all operations 0.37× to 0.69×); pandas 0.38× (all operations 0.34× to 0.38×); redis 0.39× (all operations 0.39× to 0.72×); tokio 0.40× (all operations 0.40× to 0.97×); scikit-learn 0.41× (all operations 0.29× to 0.41×); prometheus 0.43× (all operations 0.43× to 0.86×); react 0.50× (all operations 0.42× to 0.77×); next.js 0.51× (all operations 0.51× to 0.85×); vscode 0.52× (all operations 0.39× to 0.70×); kubernetes 0.76× (all operations 0.46× to 0.76×); rails 0.77× (all operations 0.55× to 0.86×); spring-boot 0.94× (all operations 0.62× to 0.94×).
